description: Add, subtract, multiply, divide or apply bitwise operators to integers in binary, hexadecimal, octal or decimal, or convert a value into every base. Optional 8, 16, 32 or 64-bit wrapping, with or without two's complement. Input is not stored.

a.description: First operand, or the value to convert

b.description: Second operand (not used for convert or not)

op.description: calculate (default) plus one of add, sub, mul, div, mod, and, or, xor, nand, nor, not, shl, shr, sar; or convert

signed.description: Treat a fixed width as signed two's complement

name: binary_calculator
title: Binary, hex, octal and decimal integer calculator
